card.name: Linking words in reference titles
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as of, on, from, or the word Update inside titles of cited papers in reference lists. They follow a noun like analysis, report, or meta-analysis.

modes.label: of after study-type noun
modes.description: The word of follows a study-type noun such as analysis, report, or results in a cited title.
modes.example: Meta-analysis<< of>> studies of alcohol and breast cancer with consideration

modes.label: on or from after a title noun
modes.description: The word on or from, or Update after a colon, links a title to its subject in a citation.

card.plain: It fires on the little words like "of" in the titles of papers listed in reference sections.
